Case Notes

Procedure: Breast Augmentation

This patient in her 20’s came to Dr. Decherd to seek his advice in hopes of a breast augmentation. She felt her breasts were too small, and she wanted a fuller look that better fit her frame. During her consultation, she went through the sizing process and decided on 695cc full profile silicone gel implants. Her implants will settle a bit more over the course of the next few months. She now feels her body is better proportioned and is loving her new curves!
